text: For fixed-design Gaussian least-squares regression over a class containing the truth whose shifted class is star-shaped, a positive critical radius satisfying the critical inequality gives squared empirical prediction error at most 16 t times that radius, with probability at least 1 minus exp(-n t times that radius divided by twice the noise variance), for t at least the radius.
scope: Paper paraphrase. Critical-radius minimality, boundary-event conventions, and the necessity of the extra nonemptiness/integrability/boundedness hypotheses in Appendix C.1 remain unresolved; no semantic label.
